title: ExoMiner and multiplicity validate 69 new exoplanets
summary: ExoMiner V1.2 combines deep learning with information about other signals in the same star system to validate 69 planets in Kepler data. This is statistical validation of transit signals, not new direct observation; the result is distinct from the 301 planets validated in 2021.

evidence.tested: ExoMiner V1.2 with multiplicity information was applied to Kepler data and validated 69 planets, compared against baseline classifiers and prior validation work.
evidence.unknown: The arXiv page states no limitations, and the statistical validation and false-positive tests are not described on the page read.
evidence.ai_role: A deep-learning classifier (ExoMiner V1.2) combined with information about other signals in the same star system to validate transit signals.
